title: Mixed Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Excelente inicio en el Nivel B2! Los Mixed Conditionals demuestran un nivel avanzado de fluidez y te permiten analizar cómo las decisiones pasadas afectan tu situación presente.

parts.visual:
En los negocios, a menudo hablamos de decisiones que tomamos en el pasado y su impacto en el presente. 
Estructura (Pasado -> Presente): 
If + Pasado Perfecto (had + participio), would + Verbo Base.
parts.audio: In business, we often talk about decisions we made in the past and their impact on the present. The structure is: If plus Past Perfect, would plus Base Verb.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: 
- If I HAD INVESTED in Apple in 2005 (pasado), I WOULD BE rich now (presente). 
- If we HADN'T HIRED him (pasado), we WOULD HAVE a lot of problems today (presente). 
- If she HAD SIGNED the contract (pasado), she WOULD BE our CEO now (presente).
parts.audio: Examples. If I had invested in Apple in 2005, I would be rich now. If we hadn't hired him, we would have a lot of problems today. If she had signed the contract, she would be our CEO now.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Completa el Mixed Conditional (decisión pasada, resultado presente).

questions.question: If I ____ harder at university, I would be a manager now. (Hubiera estudiado).
questions.explanation: If + past perfect (had studied) para la condición pasada irreal.

questions.question: If we had launched the product earlier, we ____ market leaders right now. (Seríamos).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia presente de una acción pasada: would be.

questions.question: I ____ in debt today if I hadn't taken that bank loan. (No estaría).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia presente: would not be in debt today.

questions.question: If she ____ the email yesterday, she wouldn't be angry today. (Hubiera leído).
If they had accepted our proposal, we ____ celebrating right now! (Estaríamos).
questions.explanation: Estaríamos celebrando en este momento: would be celebrating.

questions.question: If I ____ the CEO, I would have fired him last week. (Si yo fuera el CEO en general - Condición presente, acción pasada).
questions.explanation: Este es el otro tipo de mixto: Condición presente (If I were the CEO) -> resultado pasado (I would have fired him).

questions.question: If we ____ the contract, we would not have to deal with this problem today. (Hubiéramos cancelado).
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (hubiéramos cancelado) -> resultado presente (no tendríamos este problema).

questions.question: If he ____ a better leader, the company wouldn't have gone bankrupt last year. (Si él fuera un mejor líder en general).
questions.explanation: Condición presente (ser un buen líder) que afecta el pasado (la quiebra).

questions.question: If you had prepared for the meeting, you ____ so nervous right now. (No estarías).
We ____ a profitable company today if we hadn't made those mistakes. (Seríamos).
If she ____ to my advice, she would have a job right now. (Hubiera escuchado).
If they hadn't bought that software, they ____ more budget this quarter. (Tendrían).
If I didn't speak English (presente), I ____ the promotion last month (pasado). (No habría conseguido).
questions.explanation: Condición presente -> Resultado pasado irreal (would have + participio).

questions.question: If he had gone to university, he ____ an intern right now. (No sería).
questions.explanation: Right now = present result = would not be.

questions.question: If the economy ____ stronger, we would have expanded our business to Asia in 2020. (Si fuera más fuerte en general).
questions.explanation: Condición general (were) -> Resultado pasado (would have expanded).

questions.question: If you had saved more money, you ____ able to buy a house now. (Serías / Estarías).
I would understand this document now if I ____ French. (Si yo hablara - condición permanente/presente).
questions.explanation: If I spoke French (segundo condicional para hecho presente irreal).

questions.question: If the CEO hadn't resigned, the stock prices ____ so low today. (No estarían).
questions.explanation: Today = present result = would not be.

questions.question: If we ____ the deadline yesterday, we wouldn't be working on a Saturday. (No hubiéramos incumplido).
If I ____ afraid of flying, I would have attended the conference in Tokyo last week. (Si no tuviera miedo - rasgo permanente).
questions.explanation: Weren't (condición general presente) -> would have attended (resultado pasado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la forma correcta del verbo para el Mixed Conditional.

questions.question: If I ____ (have) invested earlier, I would be rich now. (Hubiera)
If we had won the contract, we ____ be happy today. (Estaríamos - modal)
If she ____ (study) finance, she would be the CFO now. (Hubiera estudiado)
I would ____ (be) the boss now if I had accepted the offer. (Sería)
If they ____ (not / launch) the product, we would have no competitors today. (No hubieran lanzado)
If I ____ (be) you, I would have fired him yesterday. (Fuera)
If we hadn't missed the deadline, the client ____ not be angry today. (Estaría)
If he ____ (save) money last year, he would have a house now. (Hubiera ahorrado)
We ____ (have) more budget now if we hadn't spent it all. (Tendríamos - 2 palabras)
If she ____ (know) how to code, she would have built the app last month. (Supiera - presente)

pairs.target: ...she would not be the CEO now.
...I would have gotten the job in Paris.
...you would not be nervous right now.

pairs.source: If we hadn't missed the deadline...

If I invested, I would be rich now.
If I had invested, I will be rich now.
If I invest, I would be rich now.
